title: Inspect the Python Runtime
prompt: Import the built-in sys module. Store the major version integer (sys.version_info.major) in a variable named major_ver, and print it.
hints: Access sys.version_info.major and assign it to major_ver.
Use print(major_ver) to display the result.
explanation: import sys loads the standard library sys module, which exposes runtime metadata such as sys.version_info.
visibleTests:
assert 'sys' in globals(), 'Make sure you imported sys'
assert major_ver == 3, f'Expected 3, got {major_ver}'

title: Dynamic Typing in Practice
prompt: Create a variable named status_code and set it to the integer 200. Then reassign status_code to the string "OK". Finally, create a variable named final_type equal to type(status_code).__name__.
explanation: In Python, variable names are labels bound to objects, so the same name can be rebound from an int to a str.
starterCode:
status_code = 200
# Reassign status_code to "OK" and set final_type
